title: Running Muse Code Models Inside Claude Code: A Setup Guide

facts.fact: The Muse Spark model family is at version 1.3 and is offered in two pricing tiers, Standard and Contributor, which the page says use the same underlying model.
facts.quote: currently on version 1.3, and it ships in two pricing tiers that are otherwise the same underlying model

facts.fact: Muse Spark's Contributor tier is priced roughly 12x lower than Standard on input tokens, according to the author's reading of the pricing table.
facts.quote: That’s roughly a **12x** discount on input and a **21x** discount on output.

facts.fact: Muse Spark's Contributor tier is priced roughly 21x lower than Standard on output tokens, according to the author's reading of the pricing table.
facts.quote: That’s roughly a **12x** discount on input and a **21x** discount on output.

facts.fact: Muse Code pricing is a pass-through of token costs with no separate license fee.
facts.quote: Pricing is a straight pass-through of token costs, no separate license fee:

facts.fact: The Standard Muse Spark tier is selected by the model ID muse-spark-1.3.
facts.quote: You select the tier by model ID (_**muse-spark-1.3**_ vs _**muse-spark-1.3-contributor**_)

facts.fact: The Contributor Muse Spark tier is selected by the model ID muse-spark-1.3-contributor.
facts.quote: You select the tier by model ID (_**muse-spark-1.3**_ vs _**muse-spark-1.3-contributor**_)

facts.fact: Under the Contributor tier, Meta uses the customer's prompts and completions to improve its products; under Standard, the author says Meta does not use them for training.
facts.quote: letting Meta use your prompts and completions to improve its products.

facts.fact: The Standard tier provides full data privacy, with Meta stating it does not use prompts or completions for training.
facts.quote: full data privacy; Meta does not use your prompts or completions for training, so they claim.

facts.fact: The Contributor tier is rate-limited well below the Standard tier, so heavy concurrent agent use may be throttled sooner on Contributor.
facts.quote: Contributor is rate-limited well below Standard, so a team running heavy concurrent agent sessions may hit throttling on Contributor before they hit it on Standard

facts.fact: Muse Spark has been reported by third parties to use more tokens per task than Claude Code on equivalent work, which reduces the headline discount.
facts.quote: Muse Spark has been reported to burn more tokens per task than Claude Code on equivalent work, which eats into the headline discount.

facts.fact: Most third-party comparisons rank Muse Code below Claude Code on raw benchmark quality but ahead of Codex CLI.
facts.quote: most third-party comparisons place Muse Code below Claude Code but ahead of Codex CLI.

facts.fact: To route Claude Code to Muse Spark, the setup sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to https://api.meta.ai.
Claude Code's Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, and subagent model variables are set to muse-spark-1.3-contributor in the setup guide.
With an unrecognized model ID such as muse-spark-1.3-contributor, Claude Code silently defaults the auto-compact window to 1 token.
facts.quote: silently defaults the **auto-compact window to 1 token**.
